snippet.title: Let's Sing 2021 mit deutschen Hits Teaser Trailer
snippet.description: Become a solo superstar or share the spotlight with your friends in Let's Sing! 30 chart breaker and all-time classics challenge you to unleash your inner rockstar in thrilling on- and offline game modes. Share 2 mics and sing with up to 8 friends in "Let's Party" and the new "Pop Chicken" mode.
